# Tracklet

> Modern job application tracking system — track, organize, and optimize your job search pipeline.

## About

Tracklet is a high-clarity job application tracker built for modern job seekers. Organize your applications across stages (Saved, Applied, Screening, Interview, Offer), track tasks and deadlines, and view analytics on your search performance.

## Features

- [Pipeline Board](https://usetracklet.netlify.app/pipeline) — Kanban-style view of active applications
- [All Applications](https://usetracklet.netlify.app/) — Full searchable table of every application
- [Analytics](https://usetracklet.netlify.app/stats) — Visual stats and charts on your job search
- CSV import/export for data portability
- Google Sign-In for cloud sync via Firebase
